results.title: Build Your First Website
results.outcome: Work with an Agent to build a clearly structured, usable website that you can verify yourself.
intentExamples: I want to build a website
Build a web page from scratch
I don't know what to learn first to build a website

results.title: Build a Product Landing Page
results.outcome: Use one clear reading path to explain the product's value, build trust, and guide visitors to act.
intentExamples: Build a website for my product
Introduce my product and get users to sign up

results.title: Build a Personal Portfolio
results.outcome: Use project evidence to show what you can do and make it easy for visitors to learn about and contact you.

results.title: Build an Admin Dashboard
results.outcome: Organize complex data and actions so people can safely complete management tasks in every key state.

results.title: Collect Information with Forms
results.outcome: Choose the right input controls, reduce entry errors, and confirm whether data was actually submitted.

results.title: Add Login and Accounts
results.outcome: Understand the full login path from page to server, then verify account state and permissions.
intentExamples: Show different content to different users

results.title: Save Data So It Lasts
results.outcome: Trace one save and read operation to find where data stops, then confirm it remains after a refresh.
intentExamples: Keep data from disappearing after a refresh
Connect my page to a database

results.title: Add an AI Feature
results.outcome: Define a well-bounded AI task and handle its output, tools, speed, failures, and cost.
intentExamples: Let AI help users process content

results.title: Make a Website Look More Polished
results.outcome: Spot the specific reasons a page feels unpolished and improve it with hierarchy, rhythm, consistency, and feedback.
intentExamples: Make my website look more polished

results.title: Make a Website Mobile-Friendly
results.outcome: Reorganize content for screen size and touch instead of simply shrinking the desktop page.
intentExamples: Make my website work on phones
My page feels cramped on a phone

results.title: Improve Usability and Accessibility
results.outcome: Help more people understand and complete key tasks with a mouse, keyboard, and assistive technology.
intentExamples: Make the site usable with a keyboard
My website is hard to use

results.title: Polish Website Interactions
results.outcome: Use consistent, restrained state feedback to make interactions feel trustworthy instead of piling on decorative animation.

results.title: Debug a Website That Isn't Responding
results.outcome: Use evidence to determine whether the failure occurs in the page, request, server, or database instead of making blind changes.
intentExamples: My saved data disappears after a refresh
My website has an error and I don't know where to look

results.title: Deploy Your Website
results.outcome: Safely publish a local project online and use real visits and logs to verify that deployment worked.
intentExamples: Let other people visit my website

results.title: Use Git Safely to Save and Change Code
results.outcome: See changes clearly, save work in stages, work in parallel, and recover from mistakes.
intentExamples: I'm worried an Agent will break my code

results.title: Learn to Build with an Agent
results.outcome: Delegate work with observable goals, control the scope of changes, and verify an Agent's work with evidence.
intentExamples: How do I get an Agent to help me write code?
AI keeps changing the wrong things
I don't know how to verify an Agent's work

results.title: Understand a Project's Tech Stack
results.outcome: Identify a project's main technology layers and know what is responsible for changing, running, and deploying it.
intentExamples: I can't understand this project's tech stack
What's the relationship between React and Next.js?
I'm taking over an unfamiliar project

results.title: Improve Website Speed and Reliability
results.outcome: Use loading evidence to find the main bottlenecks and improve resources, requests, and failure recovery.
